title: Phone Unboxing Reveal
prompt: Build one self-contained HTML page, 1080x1920 (vertical), that plays an 8-second product reveal and then holds its final frame. Look: a near-black stage (#0b0d12) with a soft pool of teal light behind the phone, an accent of #34d6be, text in #f4f6fb, and a handful of faint specks drifting upward at under 20% opacity. The headline is 104 px, weight 800, tight letter-spacing, centred, with a small uppercase {{app_name}} label (30 px, widely letter-spaced) above it. Layout: the headline block starts 230 px from the top and keeps 80 px side margins; the phone is 600x1240 px, centred, 560 px from the top, drawn in CSS with a 96 px corner radius, a graphite bezel and a 150x44 px camera island. The screen is a {{screen_colour}} gradient holding a greeting, the word Today at 64 px, a 300 px progress ring with its percentage inside, three task rows 112 px tall and a four-icon tab bar. Motion: from 0.15 to 2.4 s the phone rises from below the frame while turning from a 60-degree backward tilt to upright, with a strong quintic ease-out and no bounce; from 2.4 to 3.3 s the screen fades up from black; the ring fills to 74% between 3.1 and 4.9 s; the rows slide in from the right at 3.5, 4.1 and 4.7 s, each ticking itself done half a second later; a soft sheen sweeps across the glass from 2.6 to 4.2 s. From 5.6 s the line "{{promise_line}}" types in over 1.5 s with a caret that shows only while typing, and at 7 s the glow pulses once. Keep every label inside its container with generous padding, drive all motion from elapsed time, and use no audio, libraries or external files. Parameters: {{app_name}}, {{promise_line}}, {{screen_colour}}.

example_params.promise_line: Plan your week in one tap.
